core_points.title_en: FATF Recommendations 9-11: Secrecy Laws and Customer Due Diligence
core_points.title_zh: FATF建议9-11：保密法与客户尽职调查
core_points.reason: These units outline fundamental obligations: not allowing secrecy laws to inhibit FATF implementation, conducting CDD at specified triggers, and retaining records for at least five years.

core_points.title_en: FATF Recommendations 12-16: Additional Measures for Specific Customers and Activities
core_points.title_zh: FATF建议12-16：特定客户和活动的额外措施
core_points.reason: These units detail specific AML/CFT measures for PEPs, correspondent banking, MVTS, and new technology/wire transfers, introduced by unit 1357.

core_points.title_en: FATF Recommendations 17-19: Third-Party CDD and AML/CFT Programs
core_points.title_zh: FATF建议17-19：第三方客户尽职调查与反洗钱/反恐怖融资计划
core_points.reason: These units cover the allowance of third-party CDD reliance and the requirement to implement AML/CFT programs, share information, and apply EDD for high-risk jurisdictions.

core_points.title_en: FATF Recommendations 20-23: Suspicious Transaction Reporting and DNFBP Obligations
core_points.title_zh: FATF建议20-23：可疑交易报告与指定非金融行业义务
core_points.reason: These units specify the obligation to report suspicious transactions to FIU, legal protections, and DNFBP obligations including internal controls and supervision.
